subject: Strange Behaviour with alignment in checkboxGroupInput in Shiny App

messages.author: 35c112dbbba01008
messages.subject: Strange Behaviour with alignment in checkboxGroupInput in Shiny App
parts:
Hello everybody.

I have a shiny app in which the alignment of checkboxGroupInput options is not totally align to the left as expected. It is like it assign a margen in the second line when the option inline=TRUE. What I want is that all the options are align to the left. The red line in the picture shows the alignment in the checkboxGroupInput.

I checked this option and this one but they didn´t work for me.


In the image attached I highlight the error I´m getting. 


Any advice please.


Here is my code.


library(shiny)
ui<-fluidPage(
  titlePanel(title = "My App"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
          radioButtons("filtro1","Definir reglas:",
                   c('Todas',
                     'Filtrar'), selected = 'Todas', inline = TRUE),
      conditionalPanel("input.filtro1 === 'Filtrar'",
                       checkboxGroupInput("opcs","Lado Izquierdo:",
                                          choices = c("AAAA","BBBB","CCCC","DDDD","EEEE"),
                                          selected = 'AAAA', inline = TRUE)),
      checkboxGroupInput("anio","Seleccione un Año:", choices=c("2012","2013","2014","2015","2016"),
                         selected = '2012', inline = TRUE),
      checkboxGroupInput("tienda","Seleccione una Tienda:", choices = c("STORE1","STORE2","STORE3","STORE4","STORE5","STORE6"),
                         selected = 'STORE1', inline = TRUE),

      checkboxGroupInput("cliente","Seleccione un grupo de Cliente:", choices = c("GOLD","SILVER","BRONZE","DIAMOND","COBALT"),
                         selected = 'GOLD', inline = TRUE),
        checkboxGroupInput("categoria","Seleccione una Categoria:", choices =c("CATEGORY_A","CATEGORY_B","CATEGORY_C","CATEGORY_D"),
                         selected = "CATEGORY_A", inline = TRUE),
        sliderInput("maxlg","entrada:",
                  min=2, max = 10, value = 5, step = 1),
      ###DEFINIMOS CUANTAS REGLAS VAMOS A MOSTRAR EN EL GRÁFICO
      sliderInput("lgregla","Longitud:",
                  min=1, max = 15, value = 7, step = 1)
    ),
    mainPanel(
      tabsetPanel(
        tabPanel("Reglas",
                 dataTableOutput('contents')),
        tabPanel("Gráfico",
                 plotlyOutput("Barras"),
                 br(),
                 br(),
                 dataTableOutput('muestrav')),
        tabPanel("Data",
                 dataTableOutput('tabla'))
      )
    )
  )
)
server<-function(input,output){}
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: Strange Behaviour with alignment in checkboxGroupInput in Shiny App
parts:
Like the stackoverflow answers you linked mentioned, you have to tinker with the CSS. For example, adding this line inside the the fluidPage() function works:

ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$head(tags$style(".checkbox-inline {margin: 0 !important;}")),
  # your code
)
